name: Oracle Corporation Japan
summary: Oracle Corporation Japan provides software, hardware, and cloud products and solutions in Japan. It operates through Cloud and Software; Hardware Systems; and Services segments. The Cloud and Software segment provides software and hardware resources as services via the internet; sells software licenses for database management software, various middleware, and business application software such as ERP; and offers technical support services.
